description: This file is a Ruby script for redis-trib, a deprecated tool for managing Redis clusters. It includes functions for colorizing terminal output, parsing command-line options, generating command examples, and displays a message guiding users to use redis-cli instead.

classes.name: String
classes.description: Extended Ruby String class with methods for terminal colorization.

methods.name: colorized
methods.description: Applies terminal color codes to a string based on the specified color.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options and arguments for a given command.

methods.name: command_example
methods.description: Constructs a redis-cli command example string based on inputs.
